question: Which moments most changed Oklahoma City’s chance of winning the 2025 NBA Finals?
orientation: Rank five consequential games, injuries, and playoff moments by their expected effect on the Thunder YES contract. The resolved Finals result and full market record stay hidden until you lock your ranking.
measurementNotes: Selection order was frozen before reviewing the calculated impacts: denver-opener, chet-injury, regular-season-best, grizzlies-sweep, west-finals.
Use pairwise-anchor-1pt-v2: inclusive one-point ties with 1e-12 tolerance and no chaining. All five months-hourly windows are usable; three unrelated hourly buckets are missing from the full history.

Timing freeze v2: exact retained publication metadata is used for the WCF release and Holmgren update; timezone-naive NBA recap pages use a conservative next-day 12:00Z information bound. No price-driven timing changes were made.

NBA game recap timestamps omit timezone. Treat as date-only and use 12:00 UTC the following day, covering even UTC-12 rather than inventing a timezone. Other source timestamps use retained exact UTC metadata. These bounds are conservative and can include later news; they do not identify isolated causal effects.

market.title: Will the Oklahoma City Thunder win the 2025 NBA Finals?
market.rules: YES if Oklahoma City wins the 2024–25 NBA Championship; otherwise NO. The contract can resolve NO when the outcome becomes impossible under NBA rules. Resolution source: NBA information.
